facts.text: LangChain's Python Ollama chat integration is the langchain-ollama package; ChatOllama supports bind_tools tool calling, image input, token streaming, native async and logprobs, and the docs example uses validate_model_on_init=True.

In LlamaIndex's Ollama LLM, structured_predict sets the response format to the Pydantic class's JSON schema (overriding json_mode); tool calls are limited to one per response unless allow_parallel_tool_calls is set; tool IDs equal the tool name because Ollama supplies none; additional_kwargs merge after defaults and override temperature/num_ctx.
Install langchain-ollama and download any models you want to use from ollama.
Use the same model tag in `ollama pull` and `ChatOllama(model=...)`. The image, log probability, and custom-role examples below include separate pull commands for their models.

To access Granite 3.2's thinking features, pass a message with a `"control"` role with content set to `"thinking"`. Because `"control"` is a non-standard message role, use a [ChatMessage](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-core/messages/chat/ChatMessage) object to implement it:

Third-party guides report Ollama truncates over-long prompts silently, dropping early turns or the prompt prefix, which can remove retrieved RAG chunks or system instructions without any error.

LlamaIndex's Ollama LLM class (llama-index-llms-ollama) defaults base_url to http://localhost:11434, takes context_window=-1 (read from model info via the client, else a DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW constant), and has a thinking option (bool or low/medium/high) and a json_mode flag.

Context-length trap: Ollama's server default context depends on VRAM (under 24 GiB: 4k; 24-48 GiB: 32k; 48 GiB or more: 256k) and its docs recommend at least 64000 tokens for agents, web search and coding tools. Set num_ctx in ChatOllama or context_window/additional_kwargs in LlamaIndex, or OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH on the server, and check with ollama ps.

ChatOllama has a reasoning parameter: True returns reasoning separately in additional_kwargs reasoning_content, False disables it, None (default) leaves model behavior so think tags may appear in the main content. It can be set per call.

LlamaIndex embeds via a separate package, llama-index-embeddings-ollama (OllamaEmbedding, subclass of BaseEmbedding); LangChain uses OllamaEmbeddings inside langchain-ollama. The LlamaIndex docs example uses embeddinggemma (768-dim vectors).
The LangChain Ollama integration lives in the `langchain-ollama` package:

For detailed documentation of all features and configuration options, head to the [`ChatOllama`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-ollama/chat_models/ChatOllama) API reference. </Tip>
`ChatOllama` supports token-level log probabilities via the `logprobs` and `top_logprobs` parameters. Log probabilities indicate how likely each token was at each generation step.
For detailed documentation of all `ChatOllama` features and configuration options, see the [API reference](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-ollama/chat_models/ChatOllama).
